profiles.Summary: Bloons TD 6 is a lightweight 3D tower defense game with very modest PC requirements, making it an excellent fit for the Steam Deck — it runs well within the hardware's capabilities and should hold 60 fps with ease. ProtonDB reports a platinum rating, indicating it runs smoothly under Proton with little to no tweaking needed.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck gameplay reports were available; profiles are estimated from the very modest PC minimum requirements (OpenGL 2.0, 1.5 GHz CPU, integrated-class GPU) and the Deck's hardware capabilities — this game is well within the Deck's comfort zone. On first run, check that the frame rate stays at your cap during late-game rounds with many bloons on screen, as that is the most demanding scenario.

MaxBattery.Notes: Aggressive TDP and GPU clock limits keep the chip barely warm, squeezing maximum battery life out of this undemanding game. FSR upscaling from 960x600 is barely noticeable at Deck screen size.

KnownIssues: Touch controls are not available on the Deck's touchscreen by default; controller input works well instead.
In-app purchases may require an internet connection and could behave unexpectedly offline.
Some users on Linux/Proton report occasional audio hiccups on first launch, usually resolved by restarting.

MaxPerformance.Notes: All settings maxed with no TDP or frame-rate cap; the game is light enough that the Deck handles it effortlessly, though battery drain increases noticeably without limits. Consider capping at 60 fps in-game to avoid unnecessary GPU spin-up.

Optimal.Notes: Native 1280x800 at medium settings gives a clean, sharp image with a stable 60 fps cap; 7 W TDP is more than enough for this lightweight title and keeps temperatures comfortable.
